provenance.locator: editorial-projection artifact physical lines 238-240; antecedent 1862 text-layer lines 24214-24218; 1922 Mame printed p. 125, artifact PDF p. 239
provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1862 conclusion is the shorter cue without nostrum; 1862 text layer damages 2 place(s) in this prayer; at each the 1962 word and the layer's reading are: quesumus -> qusesumus; alimentis -> ali mentis; 1922 Mame text layer damages 2 place(s) here (chiefly its OCR of the ae/oe ligatures and of the acute accents): ieiunia -> eiunia; quesumus -> quzesumus i; both antecedents print the ae and oe ligatures and the printed acute accents, and use the j-orthography; this transcription follows the repository convention recorded in src/sources/calendars/roman-1962/propers.yaml (j retained, ae/oe digraphs written as two letters, no accent marks). Corroboration: 1922 Mame, editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (public domain), printed p. 125, artifact PDF p. 239; Benziger 1962 conformed printing OCR at djvu text line 31156 (comparison witness only, rights_status unresolved; never a publication basis); the 1604 and 1570 were not consulted for this oration - the 1862 and the 1922 Mame between them read the whole prayer.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Jejunia nostra, quaesumus, Domine, benigno favore prosequere: ut, sicut ab
alimentis abstinemus in corpore; ita a vitiis jejunemus in mente. Per
Dominum nostrum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Respice, quaesumus, Domine, propitius ad munera, quae sacramus: ut tibi
grata sint, et nobis salutaria semper exsistant. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Hujus nos, Domine, perceptio sacramenti mundet a crimine: et ad caelestia
regna perducat. Per Dominum.
